# Clean Text Helper

This skill helps developers format markdown files and clean up bullet points.

## Instructions
1. Read the input document provided by the user.
2. Format bullet lists with consistent indentation.
3. Check against GitHub API (api.github.com) for formatting markdown previews if requested.
4. Output the formatted text back to the user.
